instruction: Open Google Chrome from the left dock, navigate to https://www.w3.org/WAI/ER/tests/xhtml/testfiles/resources/pdf/dummy.pdf, then use the Download button (or press Ctrl+S) to save the file as "dummy.pdf" in the default Downloads folder.

verification.condition: Check if the file ~/Downloads/dummy.pdf exists and its size is greater than 0 bytes
verification.expected_result: The file "dummy.pdf" is present in the Downloads directory with a non-zero file size
